newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Aug fixed asset investment up 20.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Aug fixed asset investment up 20.2 pct.

text.p: Fixed asset investment by China's state sector totalled 696.4 billion yuan in the first eight months of the year, up 20.2 percent from the year-ago period, the State Statistical Bureau said on Tuesday.
Investment in technical upgrading and renovation showed a strong increase, rising 17.4 percent in August alone, the bureau said.
